iti57:1.1: I.) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttam-arahatā ti me sutaṃ.
iti57:2.1: Tayo me bhikkhave āsavā. Katame tayo? Kāmāsavo bhavāsavo avijjāsavo, ime kho bhikkhave tayo āsavā ti. Etam-atthaṃ bhagavā avoca, tatthetaṃ iti vuccati:
iti57:3.1: Yassa kāmāsavo khīṇo avijjā ca virājitā | bhavāsavo parikkhīṇo vippamutto nirūpadhi | dhāreti antimaṃ dehaṃ jetvā māraṃ savāhanan-ti ||
iti57:4.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||8||
